title: Embedding Drift: Centroid Shift and MMD
signature: def embedding_drift(ref, cur, cos_threshold, mmd_threshold) -> dict
hints: Centroid shift is 1 - cosine(mean(ref), mean(cur)). It is cheap but blind to changes that keep the mean in place.
Bandwidth: stack ref and cur, take the Euclidean distance of every unordered pair i < j once, and use the median. No self-pairs (they are all 0).
Unbiased MMD^2 drops the diagonal of the within-sample kernel matrices: divide by n(n-1) and m(m-1), and by n*m for the cross term.
Vectorize: squared distances are |a|^2 + |b|^2 - 2 a.b; clip tiny negatives to 0 before the sqrt.
